name: Bulgarian split squat
summary: Rear foot on a bench behind you, lower the front thigh to level and drive back up.
setup: Stand a long step in front of a bench, side-on to the phone, working leg nearest and the other foot resting on the bench. Lower straight down until the front thigh is level, then push back up.
brief: Stand a long step in front of a bench with the other foot resting on it. Lower straight down until the front thigh is level, then push back up.
why: From the side the front knee angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted.
regression: Split squat with the back foot on the floor.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Front knee caving inward
faults.tip: Push the knee out over the little toe.

faults.label: Trunk folding forward
faults.tip: A slight forward lean is fine; folding shifts the work to the back.

faults.label: Rear foot too high
faults.tip: A high rear foot arches the lower back. Knee height or lower is plenty.

faults.label: Stance too short
faults.tip: Too close and the front knee is driven far over the toes.

guide.surface: A stable bench that will not slide.
